description: This file defines the IBasketViewModelService interface which declares methods for retrieving and manipulating basket view models in a web application, including getting or creating baskets, counting items, and mapping basket entities to view models.

methods.name: GetOrCreateBasketForUser
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves an existing basket for a user or creates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Asynchronously counts the total number of items in a user's basket.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Transforms a Basket entity into a BasketViewModel asynchronously.
